text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While walking around town with <chrname> for a 
short break between training sessions—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Overhearing someone call out <chrname>'s name in 
French, you reflexively turn your 
attention toward the voice.

text_block_list.name: Parisian B
text_block_list.text:
"She's a Japanese Umamusume. I was 
watching UmaTube the other day and saw a 
video about some project or other."

text_block_list.name: Parisian B
text_block_list.text:
"So, watching her work so hard to make it 
to the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe kinda 
made me want to root for her, you know~?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having studied French together, <chrname> was 
clearly able to understand this 
conversation as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
People outside Japan are paying attention 
too. Knowing that, <chrname> and their Trainer felt 
their morale soar together.
